transkript.t: There are five Claude skills that most people never find because they sit inside bigger repos and nobody opens those folders.
Take the first one, Chief of Staff.
You give Claude one big goal and it runs a team of agents in the background to get it done.
And it keeps its own notes so it remembers where it left off.
But even its creator still marks it as in progress and it can burn through your usage fast.
So you give it a technical topic you're stuck on and it builds the whole thing as a model you can click through and explore.
Third is Teach, where you tell it what you want to learn and it makes your lessons and cheat sheets
and keeps track of your progress so next time you pick up right where you stopped.
Fourth is Marketing Psychology, which gives Claude more than 70 principles like loss aversion and pricing tricks for your marketing.
And fifth is Last 30 Days, where you pick a topic and it reads Reddit, X, YouTube and TikTok to tell you what people actually said about it this month.
Comment skills and I'll send you all five links with how to set each one up.
